editorial:
Imagine you are totally in love, but the only way to get the girl is to find a husband for her grumpy older sister first. That is the mess Jeff finds himself in. He wants to marry Virginia, but her sister Angelica thinks every man is boring and refuses to settle down. To fix this, Jeff comes up with a wild plan. He takes Reggie, a guy who is about as exciting as a piece of toast, and tries to trick Angelica into thinking he is a dangerous playboy. It is a classic setup that feels light, silly, and full of energy, making you root for the chaos to unfold.

What really makes this work is watching Reggie struggle to act tough while having no idea what he is doing. The comedy comes from the awkward mistakes and the funny lessons he takes way too literally. While the pacing is a bit slow in the middle, the chemistry between the characters keeps you interested. If you enjoy old-school comedies with lots of misunderstandings, you should definitely check this out. You can find it by renting it on Apple TV or adding a high-quality Blu-ray to your collection for a crisp picture.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the lies finally catch up with Reggie. Instead of being disgusted by the truth, Angelica actually finds the real, shy Reggie much more charming than the fake playboy persona. She realizes she was looking for the wrong things in a man all along. In the end, Reggie and Angelica fall in love for real, which finally clears the way for Jeff and Virginia to get married and live happily ever after.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-fashioned romantic comedies and funny misunderstandings.
